parameters.content:
## KSeF - Submit Test Invoice

**Purpose:** Integration test workflow. Opens an interactive session, submits a test FA(3) invoice to KSeF test API, and closes the session.

**Usage:** Manual trigger only. For testing end-to-end invoice flow.

**Flow:**
1. Authenticate â†’ get JWT
2. Get Ministry's public key certificate
3. Generate AES key, encrypt with RSA-OAEP
4. Open interactive session
5. Build FA(3) XML, encrypt with AES-256-CBC
6. Submit invoice
7. Check status
8. Close session

## Stage 1: Authenticate
Call the KSeF Authenticate sub-workflow to get a JWT access token.

## Stage 2: Get Public Key & Open Session
Fetch the Ministry's public key certificate, generate AES key, encrypt it, and open interactive session.

parameters.content:
## Stage 3: Build & Submit Invoice
Create FA(3) XML, encrypt with AES-256-CBC, compute hashes, submit to session.

parameters.jsCode:
const crypto = require('crypto');

const keyData = $('Generate AES Key & Encrypt').first().json;
const sessionData = $input.first().json;

const now = new Date();
const dateStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];
const tsStr = now.toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, '');
const invNum = `FV/TEST/${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}${String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}/${now.getFullYear()}`;

const due = new Date(now.getTime() + 14*24*60*60*1000);
const dueStr = due.toISOString().split('T')[0];

// Complete schema-valid FA(3) test invoice
// Validated against XSD from crd.gov.pl/wzor/2025/06/25/13775/schemat.xsd
// Key rules:
// - Element order in Fa: ...P_15, Adnotacje, RodzajFaktury, FaWiersz, Platnosc
// - FaWiersz uses NrWierszaFa (not NrWiersza)
// - Adnotacje: P_16,P_17,P_18,P_18A,Zwolnienie,NoweSrodkiTransportu,P_23,PMarzy
const invoiceXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Faktura xmlns="http://crd.gov.pl/wzor/2025/06/25/13775/">
  <Naglowek>
    <KodFormularza kodSystemowy="FA (3)" wersjaSchemy="1-0E">FA</KodFormularza>
    <WariantFormularza>3</WariantFormularza>
    <DataWytworzeniaFa>${tsStr}</DataWytworzeniaFa>
    <SystemInfo>KSeF-n8n-Platform v1.0</SystemInfo>
  </Naglowek>
  <Podmiot1>
    <DaneIdentyfikacyjne>
      <NIP>1111111111</NIP>
      <Nazwa>Firma Testowa Sp. z o.o.</Nazwa>
    </DaneIdentyfikacyjne>
    <Adres>
      <KodKraju>PL</KodKraju>
      <AdresL1>ul. Testowa 1, 00-001 Warszawa</AdresL1>
    </Adres>
  </Podmiot1>
  <Podmiot2>
    <DaneIdentyfikacyjne>
      <NIP>2222222222</NIP>
    </DaneIdentyfikacyjne>
    <Adres>
      <KodKraju>PL</KodKraju>
      <AdresL1>ul. Przykladowa 10, 00-002 Krakow</AdresL1>
    </Adres>
    <JST>2</JST>
    <GV>2</GV>
  </Podmiot2>
  <Fa>
    <KodWaluty>PLN</KodWaluty>
    <P_1>${dateStr}</P_1>
    <P_2>${invNum}</P_2>
    <P_6>${dateStr}</P_6>
    <P_13_1>1000.00</P_13_1>
    <P_14_1>230.00</P_14_1>
    <P_15>1230.00</P_15>
    <Adnotacje>
      <P_16>2</P_16>
      <P_17>2</P_17>
      <P_18>2</P_18>
      <P_18A>2</P_18A>
      <Zwolnienie>
        <P_19N>1</P_19N>
      </Zwolnienie>
      <NoweSrodkiTransportu>
        <P_22N>1</P_22N>
      </NoweSrodkiTransportu>
      <P_23>2</P_23>
      <PMarzy>
        <P_PMarzyN>1</P_PMarzyN>
      </PMarzy>
    </Adnotacje>
    <RodzajFaktury>VAT</RodzajFaktury>
    <FaWiersz>
      <NrWierszaFa>1</NrWierszaFa>
      <P_7>Usluga testowa - integracja KSeF</P_7>
      <P_8B>1</P_8B>
      <P_9A>1000.00</P_9A>
      <P_11>1000.00</P_11>
      <P_12>23</P_12>
    </FaWiersz>
    <Platnosc>
      <TerminPlatnosci>
        <Termin>${dueStr}</Termin>
      </TerminPlatnosci>
    </Platnosc>
  </Fa>
</Faktura>`;

const invoiceBuffer = Buffer.from(invoiceXml, 'utf-8');

const invoiceHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(invoiceBuffer).digest('base64');
const invoiceSize = invoiceBuffer.length;

const aesKey = Buffer.from(keyData.aes_key_hex, 'hex');
const iv = Buffer.from(keyData.iv_hex, 'hex');

const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', aesKey, iv);
let encrypted = cipher.update(invoiceBuffer);
encrypted = Buffer.concat([encrypted, cipher.final()]);

const encryptedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(encrypted).digest('base64');
const encryptedSize = encrypted.length;

return [{
  json: {
    session_reference: sessionData.referenceNumber,
    access_token: keyData.access_token,
    invoice_hash: invoiceHash,
    invoice_size: invoiceSize,
    encrypted_invoice_hash: encryptedHash,
    encrypted_invoice_size: encryptedSize,
    encrypted_invoice_content: encrypted.toString('base64'),
    original_xml_preview: invoiceXml.substring(0, 500) + '...'
  }
}];

## Stage 4: Verify & Close
Check invoice processing status and close the session.
